Name: Postbox Building
Author: isaacb539
Description:
[size=6][b]Postbox Mod[/b]
[/size][size=3]Adds a new building that allows sending gifts to NPCs from your farm! No more chasing your favorite villager halfway across the map, or realizing too late that you forgot their schedule.

Thanks to Katie Pearson for the lovely art assets!
[/size]
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=3]New building in Robin's construction menu: the Postbox! Accepts gifts and sends them to NPCs overnight. 
Provides a slight debuff to relationship points gained from gifts given this way (configurable; default 25% reduction)
Compatible with custom NPCs and items!

Simply right click the Postbox to begin selecting the gift recipient, then right click with your gift to ship it! If you pick the wrong NPC, you can right click with any non-giftable to re-open the selection menu again.
[/size]
[size=5][b]Install
[/b][/size][size=3]This mod requires [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
For any advice on how to start modding please refer to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]the wiki[/url]﻿.
Run using SMAPI and enjoy!
If you enjoy this mod, please consider endorsing! More people will be able to see it, and it provides me with feedback :)
[/size]
[b][size=5]Configurability[/size]
[/b][size=3]Configurable relationship point penalty for mailed gifts (Default: .75, equal to a 25% reduction)
Configurable G cost (Default: 2500)
Configurable Material cost:[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Free: No materials![/size]
[*][size=3]Normal (Default): 2 Iron Bars | 5 Clay | 50 Stone[/size]
[*][size=3]Expensive: 10 Iron Bars | 5 Gold Bars | 1 Iridium Bar[/size]
[*][size=3]Endgame: 10 Iridium Bars | 5 Radioactive Bars | 10 Battery Packs | 1 Prismatic Shard[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom: Loads from the CustomPostboxMaterialCost string. Formatted as one string, "itemId itemCount itemId itemCount [etc.]" (Check out https://stardewlist.com/ for easy item ID lookups!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Verbose Gifting: Send chat messages overnight to log your outgoing gifts (Default: false)[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.6, as well as a legacy version for 1.5.6, in both singleplayer and multiplayer!
In multiplayer any players without the mod will be unable to interact with the building, but should otherwise be fine.

[b]Please report any bugs either here or on GitHub, especially following the update to Stardew Valley 1.6!
[/b]
There are no known or expected [b]hard[/b] incompatibilities with other mods, unless they greatly modify how Robin's building interface/building logic in general works. Playing with this and Reciprocate can cause some quirky behavior as NPCs try to give you items while you aren't present.[/size]

[b][size=5]Translation
[/size][/b][size=3]This mod was written with SMAPI's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Translation]i18n translation API[/url]. If you have the desire and ability to contribute a translation to this (admittedly small) mod, feel free to reach out or make a pull request.
